name: engine-stripping-p1-physics
title: Engine stripping stage 1: the per-project module list, the scan and the build check, with 3D and 2D physics as the first modules
issue: User's go on 2026-11-09. Design: orchestrator/proposals/engine-stripping-design.md, stage 1 of section 7. Implements J10 of the physics plan.
acceptance: A project's build.modules decides the physics options through -DN2ENGINE_PROJECT, on the web and natively; a project with no list builds everything
A list that contradicts the project fails at configure time and at link, naming the file and line
A web package with no physics builds, starts and draws in CI, and the GCC leg runs engine_tests built from the same list
The measured saving is recorded; the full build's behaviour and budgets are unchanged
notes: Reviewer: that the options the list sets really win over the cache, that nothing physics-related stays linked, and that a project with no list configures exactly as before.
